name: Open external browser
description: Starts a temporary Peer-managed Chromium session for the current conversation. Isolated from the in-app Browser workspace and from the user's daily browser profile.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 为当前会话启动一个临时的 Peer 托管 Chromium 会话，与内嵌浏览器和工作日常 Profile 隔离。
localizedDescription.en-US: Starts a temporary Peer-managed Chromium session for the current conversation, isolated from the in-app Browser and the user's daily profile.

url.description: Optional absolute http(s) URL to open after the session starts.
